executable_actions.rationale: This action is conditional on a fresh replay with the repaired current identity again producing SIGSEGV or another pre-terminal exit without a last source location/event. The remote VCS runner and evidence analyzer then lack a necessary capability to distinguish infrastructure termination from deterministic HDL termination. Multi-agent-system implementation of that capability is required before selecting a hardware repair.

If a direct named lower-layer invariant contradiction is proven, create a targeted lower-layer backtrack request and rerun that limited lower scope before rerunning this board layer.

executable_actions.rationale: For a normally completed fresh replay that still fails, map the earliest observed board-layer violation to a current causal slice before any patch. Preserve certified elastic kernel semantics and reopen a lower layer only on a direct trace contradiction of a named current certificate invariant.

observations: Current board-layer status is needs_repair: case_axi_ddr_interface failed because the simulation source identity, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the current exact sample-project identity. The current functional_sim failure is dependency closure, not executed simulator evidence.

The debug closure classifies this as a verification-capability gap with no failed boundary, no root candidate module, and no current lower-layer challenge. It explicitly blocks requesting a hardware boundary trace until the semantic board-harness capability is repaired.

Hash-validated operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. The connected kernel is certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline with preserved boundary order and cross-token overlap; unequal same-token stage duration is not a defect. No current trace names an invariant contradicted by board evidence.

Prior exact-hash VCS SIGSEGV feedback is useful failure history but cannot localize the present run because the associated diagnosis is historical-only after a live source-hash change. A fresh replay must be bound to the repaired current identity before it can establish whether termination is runner-owned or source-event-owned.

sacg_memory_truth has 15 active current-scope contamination barriers and six open retry requests (retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144); there are zero in-scope open backtrack requests. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only and cannot support promotion.
The conditional design-team route returned no_split. It does not replace the failed deterministic checker or provide authority for an RTL patch.

The missing board semantic-evidence report and not_run downstream gates are consequences of the identity-gate failure. They must be generated by a normally completed real simulation, never synthesized or relaxed from stale reports.
proposed_actions: Rebuild only the current exact-board simulation identity and canonical compile-plan bindings from discovered user-project and Vivado-export facts; preserve immutable sources, model-reference inputs, and numeric policy.
After the identity gate passes, execute a fresh hash-bound VCS board replay using the immutable Transformer-block target reference and obtain real termination and boundary evidence.

If the replay completes with a real board failure, localize and targeted-replay the earliest current-layer causal boundary before authorizing any wrapper/runtime patch; request lower-layer backtrack only on a direct named-invariant contradiction.
If the replay again ends in an unclassified SIGSEGV, add the missing runner/analyzer termination-provenance capability under approval rather than modifying RTL or fabricating dynamic reports.
Only after a normally completed replay, run the remaining current board-layer DAG and assemble real semantic evidence; rerun Stage7 and keep promotion blocked on any failure.
risks: Editing wrapper RTL, the certified kernel, or leaf modules now would be speculative: no current completed trace provides direct core-start, ingress, egress, named-boundary, and current-certificate evidence contradicting a lower-layer invariant.

Changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model oracle, expected outputs, comparison tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, source hashes, or using DUT/random output as expected data would invalidate the repair loop. Accelerator semantic scope remains Transformer blocks only; model-tail functions must not enter DUT golden or weight-coverage requirements.
An output-frontier absence, independent AXI/prefetch activity, or a pre-terminal simulator exit is localization information only; none proves liveness, board correctness, or an RTL root cause.

If a newly bound VCS replay again terminates with SIGSEGV without untruncated source/event context, the current runner/analyzer lacks required termination-provenance capability. That is a checker/framework capability blocker, not hardware correctness evidence.

The active barriers and open retries block consumption of prior failed results and all backend, bitstream, runtime-ABI, and board-runtime promotion until a fresh Stage7 board certificate passes every required gate.
